title.l2: Follow so you don’t miss it

lines.text: Three oh seven A.M. The Pinewood Motel.
Daniel had worked the night shift here for six years. Nothing ever happened.
The little screen said, Room nine.
Front desk. How can I help you?
Please... don't send anyone up. He's still in here with me.
Daniel froze. Room nine had been sealed for three years. Ever since the fire.
He looked at the key board. Hook number nine was empty.
He grabbed the flashlight and climbed the stairs. The door to room nine was open.
I told you. Not to come up.
But this time, the voice wasn't coming from a phone. It was right behind him.
